articles.title: Icelandic voters reject a proposal to restart negotiations to join the European Union - AP News
articles.description: Iceland's voters have rejected a referendum to restart negotiations to join the European Union. RÚV, the national broadcaster, said opponents defeated the measure by a margin of 52.8% to 47.2%. The result will put the issue to rest for the second time about a…
